business_description: Artisanal aromas brand based in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. Handcrafted candles, diffusers, sprays, souvenirs, and gifts — all 100% soy wax in amber glass containers. 3 product lines: Vela Aromática (5.5oz candle, ~30hr burn, RD$800), Linen & Room Spray (2oz, RD$500), Difusor de Varillas de Caña (2oz reed diffuser, 5-8 weeks, RD$750). 7 fragrances: Lavanda & Ámbar, Lino Blanco, Caoba & Coco, Palo Santo & Pachulí, Vainilla, Rocío & Té, Eucalipto & Menta. Each fragrance has poetic descriptions and scent notes. Orders via WhatsApp (829) 775-6348, payment via bank transfer (BHD or Popular), delivery from RD$250. Offers: free sample kit (pay shipping only), free gift wrapping, fiscal invoice (NCF), custom products. Goal: drive online sales through WhatsApp cart flow (reference ~/repos/kwihub/tea-cup/ for AddToCart/CartBadge/CartPage pattern). Bilingual landing page (Spanish + English). Include a demo banner at the top — this is a proposition for the business owner.
brand_colors_fonts: Colors: #763b13 (brown accent — headings, CTAs, numbered badges), #232323 (base text), #d2b299 (warm beige — backgrounds, soft accents). Fonts: Bon Voyage (free, elegant serif with swash details — used for display headings like 'Catálogo', 'Aromas Disponibles', 'Vela aromática'), plus a calligraphic/script font for the 'Lisenza Studio' logo wordmark.
